factor_diagnostics.value_notes: IPHC reports summer feeding on the continental shelf to about 500 m, most frequent captures around 30-270 m, and deeper offshore winter spawning. NOAA/USGS sources describe ontogenetic depth shifts, including juveniles in shallow water and spawning at roughly 183-457 m. The configured 20-250 m band covers much feeding habitat but does not represent the full life-stage or winter spawning depth range.
